name: Addict
body:
You spent several years addicted to a drug that you may or may not have kicked.

Benefit: You start with only half of the normal starting cash, but your knowledge of the addicts lifestyle grants you a +1 trait bonus on Bluff, Knowledge (local), and Sense Motive checks.

One of these skills (your choice) is always a class skill for you.
